recipes.name: Complementary colors
recipes.description: Each light shows the opposite hue of its part of the screen, so green on screen gives red lights. Greys and blacks have no hue and stay as they are.

recipes.name: Loudness switch
recipes.description: Two looks that swap when the music gets loud. A small band around the threshold stops the lights flickering between them. It is set for music at a normal volume, so move Loudness threshold if it stays on one look.

recipes.name: Bass, mids and treble as RGB
recipes.description: Bass drives red, mids green and treble blue, added together, so the room's color follows the balance of the music. Treble is quieter than bass, so blue is always the dimmest. Raise Color smoothing if the lights flicker.

recipes.name: VU meter fill
recipes.description: A bar of color fills across the room with the music's level. Turn the bar size down for a single dot that slides along instead. It is set for music at a normal volume, so lower Loudness for a full bar if the bar never fills.
recipes.layout: Fills along your zone layout, so the result depends on where your lights sit

recipes.name: Beat-stepped chase
recipes.description: A rainbow across the room that steps forward on every beat and holds still between them.
recipes.layout: Spreads across your zone layout, so the result depends on where your lights sit

recipes.name: Candles
recipes.description: Warm, flickering candle light that needs no input. Each light flickers on its own.
recipes.layout: Each zone flickers on its own, so the look depends on how many zones you have

recipes.name: Audio color over the screen
recipes.description: The screen's colors with a drifting audio color layered on top. The louder the music, the more of it shows. It is set for music at a normal volume, so lower Loudness for full audio color if the audio color stays faint.
